Configure current feature

  1. Activate full party invites/leadership/leave UI using existing minimal contract. Add chat/local/zone/party/private routing, friends/block and moderation policy.
  2. Enable two-party secure trade escrow in the single backend database: offers carry revisions, both accept the same revision, final ownership/currency exchange is atomic.

Run now: current-phase integrated scenarios

  1. A invites B; B accepts; change leader, leave and reconnect. Confirm group XP/quest sharing uses authored eligibility rather than all online friends.
  2. Send zone/party/private messages, exceed rate limits and block A from B. Confirm channel membership/privacy and localized rejection.
  3. A offers sword/currency, B offers potion. Both accept same version; commit one exchange. Modify offer after one acceptance and verify both acceptances reset.
  4. Disconnect during final trade uncertainty and reconnect; inspect single receipt/escrow resolution.
Expected success
Party relationship version is consistent across zones. Blocking affects contact/delivery/invites without exposing hidden presence.
Trade commits both sides completely or leaves/releases escrow by recovery policy; no duplicated item or partial debit.

Explicitly not active yet

  1. Guild21; auction house/PvP/housing/monetization remain deferred expansions. No guild bank or mail-item attachment system implied.

Regression, disconnect and restart

  1. Restart the test environment twice; one admitted pawn per account, one local input context installation, no stale widgets.
  2. Repeat the previous phase success case after all new assignments; definitions missing from this phase must fail closed, not fall back to client saves.
  3. From phase03 onward run two separate clients; disconnect A while B remains, then reconnect with the correct identity.
  4. From phase05 onward query committed receipt/revision after timeout/restart. From06 onward reject old source epoch after transfer.

Stop condition and deferred work

Blocking and moderation affect delivery; both trade acceptances bind one offer revision.

Stop on a failed required assertion, missing required rule definition, duplicate authority or unverified dependency that this phase relies on. Legal debug art may support physics tests but cannot close the archive/PaperZD art gate. Do not activate future-phase systems merely because their full-game chapter exists.
